#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const long long INF = 1000000000000000001LL;

long long nCr[100][100];

long long f(long long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p *= nCr[a][b];
    p %= MOD;
    p *= nCr[c][d];
    p %= MOD;
    return p;
}

struct State {
    long long d;
    int x, y, z;
    State(long long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

void relax(queue<State>& q, vector<vector<vector<long long>>>& dist,
           vector<vector<vector<long long>>>& dp,
           int nx, int ny, int nz, long long nd, long long ways) {
    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= nd) {
        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > nd) {
            dist[nx][ny][nz] = nd;
            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
            q.push(State(nd, nx, ny, nz));
        } else {
            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i)
                nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int w;
        cin >> w;
        if (w == 50)
            cnt1++;
        else
            cnt2++;
    }

    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dist(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, INF)));
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, 0)));

    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;
    queue<State> q;
    q.push(State(0, 0, 0, 0));

    while (!q.empty()) {
        State cur = q.front();
        q.pop();
        int x = cur.x, y = cur.y, z = cur.z;
        long long d = dist[x][y][z];

        if (z == 0) {
            int remX = cnt1 - x;
            int remY = cnt2 - y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    long long ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                    relax(q, dist, dp, x + i, y + j, z ^ 1, d + 1, ways);
                }
            }
        } else {
            int remX = x;
            int remY = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    long long ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                    relax(q, dist, dp, x - i, y - j, z ^ 1, d + 1, ways);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF) {
        cout << -1 << '\n';
    } else {
        cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';
    }
    cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';

    return 0;
}
